original_question: Prove the BKL locality conjecture for generic inhomogeneous cosmological spacetimes, namely that the asymptotic approach to a generic spacelike singularity becomes effectively local along each timeline.
target_in_paper: Section 5.2, Problem P14: Prove the BKL locality conjecture in the general inhomogeneous context. ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the right target: the locality part of the BKL picture, in the generic inhomogeneous cosmological setting, near a generic spacelike singularity. It also captures the intended heuristic idea that the approach becomes effectively local along timelines. ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))
missing_details: The paper places the problem explicitly within classical general relativity, not in a broader class of gravitational theories. ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))
The singularity is specifically a past spacelike singularity in a generic inhomogeneous cosmology. ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))

Problem P14 isolates only the locality component of the full BKL claim; the surrounding paragraph separately states the full BKL picture as vacuum dominated, local, and oscillatory (mixmaster). ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))

The nearby heuristic explanation of locality is asymptotic silence: particle horizons shrink to zero size toward the singularity, so communication between different timelines becomes asymptotically impossible. Your draft suggests this, but does not state it explicitly. ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))

The phrase along each timeline is slightly stronger than the paper-faithful wording, because the immediately following spike discussion notes numerical evidence for exceptional locations where the asymptotic locality part of BKL is violated. ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))

The original open problem is not theorem-level formalized: it does not specify a regularity class, spacetime dimension/signature, a precise notion of genericity, or exact asymptotic quantifiers. A stand-alone rewrite should therefore sharpen the scope without inventing hypotheses the paper does not supply. ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))
refined_question: Within classical general relativity, prove the locality part of the Belinskii-Khalatnikov-Lifshitz (BKL) conjecture in the general inhomogeneous cosmological setting: for a generic inhomogeneous cosmology approaching a past spacelike singularity, show that the asymptotic evolution becomes local near the singularity, in the sense intended in the paper that particle horizons shrink to zero and communication between distinct timelines is asymptotically suppressed. ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))
justification: This is the nearest official formulation in the paper and is clearly the one your draft is trying to capture. The surrounding text in Section 5.2 first states the full BKL picture for generic inhomogeneous cosmologies in GR, then explains the locality intuition via shrinking particle horizons and asymptotic silence, and then singles out locality itself as Problem P14. The immediately following spike discussion belongs to the separate Problem P15 and shows why a paper-faithful rewrite should not silently strengthen P14 into an unconditional every-timeline claim. ([prawobrzeze.info](https://prawobrzeze.info/userfiles/file/zodemiwalib.pdf))
